title: SensitivityRequest
description: Core asks the engine to pool a car's sensitivity profile from its finished experiments (POST /sensitivity/update).

measurements.description: Every channel result of the car's finished one-item experiments, with its stratum.

transfers.description: Pooled effects of other cars, for items this car has not measured.

ropes.description: Band of practical equivalence per channel the experiments froze; the engine's margins configuration overrides it per item.

level.description: Confidence level of the intervals, as in the experiments.

Measurement.title: Measurement
Measurement.description: One channel result of one finished one-item experiment on this car, with the stratum it belongs to.

parameter.description: Item id in the game's setup.

clicks.description: Signed clicks of the variant against its baseline.

phase.description: Corner phase the effect is measured over; corner for the whole corner.

track.description: The track the experiments were driven on (game id and layout, a _paddock test copy counted as its layout, ADR 0027), or all for a row pooled over every track.

track_name.description: What the dashboard calls the track.

hint_bucket.description: The AI's planning share of the car's tyre hint, to the nearest 0.01 (ADR 0028): pinned on the experiment or read from its run context. unknown when the experiment was driven before run context was recorded, none for a human driver.

baseline_value.description: Raw value of the item on the experiments' baseline.

click_step.description: Raw size of one click of the item.

estimate.description: Variant minus baseline, in the channel's unit, per corner pass.

ci_low.description: The ledger's interval at the request's level: given (and read) only for a stale row, which has no standard error.

standard_error.description: Block-level standard error from the current engine (re-derived); absent for stale rows.

df.description: Degrees of freedom of that standard error.

stale.description: True when the numbers are the ledger's because the current engine could not re-derive the experiment.

note.description: Why a stale row could not be re-derived; empty otherwise.

finding_class.description: The experiment's finding (ADR 0029): the re-derivation's, or the ledger's for a stale row. invalid is never pooled.

engine_version.description: Engine version that computed the numbers.

Transfer.title: Transfer
Transfer.description: A pooled effect of another car's item with the same role and axle, offered as a prior for this car's item.

source_car.description: Name of the car it was measured on.

phase.description: Corner phase the effect is measured over; corner for the whole corner.

estimate.description: Variant minus baseline, in the channel's unit, per corner pass.
